newsitem.title: JAPAN: NTT president welcomes WTO telecoms agreement.
newsitem.headline: NTT president welcomes WTO telecoms agreement.

text.p: Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp president Junichiro Miyazu welcomed an agreement struck over the weekend to liberalise most of the world"s telecommunications market.
The World Trade Organisation agreed on February 15 on plans to liberalise the telecoms markets of 69 of its 130 member nations in a deal covering more than 90 percent of the global market.

"We view the result of the talks as positive for the company as we are seeking to actively expand into international services and participate in global competition," Miyazu said in a statement issued on Sunday.
